create_mps_stub_install: install torch.mps stubs to provide CUDA-compatible APIs for Apple Silicon devices
create_mps_stream_context: create a no-op CUDA Stream context manager for MPS device-agnostic code paths
create_mps_event_timing: create CUDA Event stubs for timing operations on MPS devices
create_mps_memory_tracker: create a memory tracker that reports peak allocated and reserved memory on MPS devices
patch_mps_non_blocking_copies: patch Tensor.to and Tensor.copy_ to disable non_blocking transfers on MPS devices
